change.source: F2 lib.rs:514 acceptance blocker NEEDS-CHANGE introduced: the resume branch granted append authority over a prefix the process had not re-read, so an append onto damaged bytes left a store no opener accepts. Fixed in bot commit 9f234c5d09b234cf207d5d8a311ac8a642c6bc69: append authority is only handed out through resume, which now makes the prefix check under the process lock; case an_open_handle_does_not_commit_onto_a_history_it_can_no_longer_validate green, plus a new durability case for refusal without altering the history
